action_name: Lowering Financial Barriers for Building Nursing Homes
description_of_action: Reduces the 25% equity contribution nursing homes must make toward construction projects, lowering the capital threshold for facility modernization.

action_name: Reducing Barriers for Prefabricated Housing Moves
description_of_action: Eliminates the $25,000 bonding requirement for transporting manufactured homes 14–16 feet wide, reducing delivery costs for prefabricated housing.

action_name: Eliminating Fees for Commercial Measuring Devices
description_of_action: Repeals the $100 application fee for commercial weighing and measuring devices (e.g., milk meters, grocery scales, EV chargers); already-approved models are now approved at no cost.

action_name: Eliminating Fees for Leashed Tracking Dog Licenses
description_of_action: Repeals the $25 application fee for leashed tracking dog licenses.

action_name: Streamlining Occupational Licensing Renewal Applications
description_of_action: Cuts required information on the renewal form by 67% for 800,000+ licensees by consolidating background questions and removing the continuing education listing; a mobile-friendly online renewal service is in development.

action_name: Streamlining Historic Preservation Reviews for Affordable Housing
agency: Office of Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation (OPRHP); Homes and Community Renewal (HCR)
description_of_action: Narrows the evaluation used to determine which HCR-funded projects require state historic preservation review, shortening timelines for affordable housing delivery.

action_name: Streamlining Nurse Aide Training
description_of_action: Reduces nurse aide training requirements from 100 to 75 hours, aligning with the federal minimum to address workforce shortages.

action_name: Streamlining Medicaid Paperwork and Reporting for Healthcare Providers
description_of_action: Replaces dozens of repetitive Medicaid documentation and recordkeeping requirements with a single cross-referenced standard.

action_name: Reducing Barriers to Entry for Nursing Home Administrators
description_of_action: Shortens the Administrator in Training program from 12 to 9 months, expands qualifying practice areas, and lowers preceptor experience requirements from 3 years to 1.

action_name: Digitizing Medicaid Workflows for Healthcare Providers
description_of_action: Explicitly authorizes digital signatures and online forms for Medicaid administration.

action_name: Accelerating Recertification for Addiction Services Providers
agency: Office of Addiction Services and Supports (OASAS)
description_of_action: Shifts recertification review from the individual program to the organizational level, reducing duplicative document requests, site visits, and corrective action plans.

action_name: Modernizing Standards for Substance Use Disorder Outpatient Programs
agency: Office of Addiction Services and Supports (OASAS)
description_of_action: Technical updates to terminology and alignment with federal changes; removes the separate certification requirement for outpatient rehabilitation programs.

action_name: Streamlining Incident Reporting Across Supportive Services
agency: Office of Addiction Services and Supports (OASAS)
description_of_action: Allows use of the OMH digital incident reporting system, eliminating double entry for dual-licensed programs.

action_name: Increasing Efficiency and Flexibility in Scheduling of Settlements
description_of_action: Removes restrictive language on scheduling and timing of settlements to speed case resolution.

action_name: Cutting Paperwork for Small Daily Purchases
agency: Office for People With Developmental Disabilities (OPWDD)
description_of_action: Raises the personal allowance threshold from $15 to $25, reducing paperwork for minor daily purchases.

action_name: Modernizing Thruway Advertising Rules
description_of_action: Eliminates the permit requirement for on-premises advertising, aligning with State DOT and federal standards; affects nearly 100 roadside businesses.

action_name: Modernizing Municipal Utility Billing
description_of_action: Consolidates redundant bill content and timely billing requirements for gas, electric, steam, and water service; aligns with recent Public Service Law changes.

action_name: Digitizing Escort Vehicle Identification
description_of_action: Replaces paper escort certificates with a "J" endorsement printed on the driver's license.

action_name: Modernizing Safety Belt Approval Processes for Auto Manufacturers
description_of_action: Updates 1975-era safety belt approval rules by removing physical sample requirements and recognizing AMECA in place of AAMVA.

action_name: Improved Process and Forms for Requesting Claims Records
description_of_action: Revises the records request process and forms to eliminate deficiencies; cuts processing to 7 business days (10 fewer) and saves staff up to 100 hours monthly across 3,000+ requests.

action_name: Narrowing the Asian Longhorned Beetle Quarantine Areas
description_of_action: Narrows the quarantine area following successful eradication, lifting wood movement restrictions on maple and timber industries.

action_name: Digital Access to Public Hearings
description_of_action: Authorizes video conferencing, online submissions, and e-filing for public hearings.

action_name: Streamlining the Victim Compensation Process
description_of_action: Allows digital document submission, adds rideshare as a compensable expense, raises the burial reimbursement cap, and removes the law enforcement reporting prerequisite for services.

action_name: Modernizing Crime Victim Programs
description_of_action: Expands activities eligible for local program funding and removes information requests the office no longer needs.

action_name: Updating No-Fault Insurance Forms
description_of_action: Supports online portal submission of no-fault insurance forms, replacing paper processes for hundreds of thousands of annual arbitration requests.

action_name: Modernizing the MWBE Program
description_of_action: Package of updates including a Professional Declaration of Eligibility (≈50% faster review for licensed professionals), mandatory liaison training, quarterly agency reporting, and clarified eligibility and utilization plan procedures.

action_name: Expanding Telehealth in Assisted Living
description_of_action: Guidance clarifies that telehealth may be used in Adult Care Facility and Assisted Living settings following an initial in-person assessment.

action_name: Increasing Flexibility for Mental Health Clinics
description_of_action: Adds flexibility for MHOTRS providers to address health-related social needs and preventive interventions, and sets standards for safe discharge from inpatient and emergency settings.

action_name: Streamlining Certification for Detox and Rehab Facilities
agency: Office of Addiction Services and Supports (OASAS)
description_of_action: Creates a single certification covering both detoxification and inpatient rehabilitation services.

action_name: Expanding Access and Reducing Barriers for the Addiction Services Workforce
agency: Office of Addiction Services and Supports (OASAS)
description_of_action: Expands the Qualified Health Professional definition to include credentialed prevention professionals and specialists with bachelor's degrees.

action_name: Making It Easier for Relatives to Foster
agency: Office of Children and Family Services (OCFS)
description_of_action: Establishes separate, flexible standards for kinship foster homes.

action_name: Reducing Red Tape in Public Assistance Programs
agency: Office of Temporary and Disability Assistance (OTDA)
description_of_action: Allows domestic violence survivors to self-attest for program requirement waivers in place of credibility assessments; raises the non-fraud overpayment recovery threshold from $125 to $2,500.

action_name: Improving Administration of SSA Benefits
agency: Office for People With Developmental Disabilities (OPWDD)
description_of_action: Loosens restrictive rules governing provider management of SSA benefits for individuals in care.

action_name: Rescinding Y2K Bug Guidelines
description_of_action: Rescinds late-1990s guidelines addressing the Y2K date bug.

action_name: Repealing Outdated Labor Regulations: Air Contaminant Standards
description_of_action: Removes 1970s air contaminant control standards preempted by federal OSHA requirements.

action_name: Repealing Outdated Labor Regulations: 1920s Building Code
description_of_action: Removes a 1920s building code superseded by local municipal codes and modern state building standards.

action_name: Repealing Outdated Labor Regulations: Ionizing Radiation Rules
description_of_action: Removes radiation safety rules for which DOH assumed responsibility following 2008 legislative changes.

action_name: Repealing Outdated Labor Regulations: Laser Examining Board
description_of_action: Removes regulations tied to the laser examining board dissolved by the Legislature in 2006.

action_name: Repealing Outdated Labor Regulations: Invalid Licensing and Inspection Fees
description_of_action: Removes licensing and inspection fees invalidated by the transfer of oversight to DOH.

action_name: Repealing Outdated Labor Regulations: 9/11 Recovery Contract Registry
description_of_action: Removes the 9/11 recovery contract registry following repeal of the underlying law in 2008.

action_name: Repealing Outdated Labor Regulations: Truck and Bus Driving Hours
description_of_action: Removes driving hour rules for truck and bus operators superseded by the State Transportation Law.

action_name: Repealing Outdated Labor Regulations: Women Working After Midnight Permit
description_of_action: Removes an unenforced 1950s rule requiring restaurant owners to obtain a permit for women to work after midnight.

action_name: Repealing Outdated Labor Regulations: Employment Standards for 14- and 15-Year-Olds
description_of_action: Removes 1960s-era employment standards for minors superseded by modern Labor Law protections.

action_name: Repealing Outdated Labor Regulations: 1973 Youth Safety Program Approval
description_of_action: Removes an unused 1973 approval process for youth machinery safety programs.

action_name: Repealing Outdated Labor Regulations: Labor Dispute Investigation Procedures
description_of_action: Removes procedural rules for investigating labor disputes, now handled by PERB.

action_name: Repealing Outdated Labor Regulations: Homemaker Program Training Allowances
description_of_action: Removes 1974 and 1980s training allowance rules replaced by federal USDOL programs or discontinued.

action_name: Repealing Outdated Labor Regulations: Council of Contracting Agencies
description_of_action: Removes requirements for the inactive 1980s Council of Contracting Agencies.

action_name: Repealing Outdated Labor Regulations: Labor Statistics Calculation Method
description_of_action: Removes a superseded method for calculating labor statistics.

action_name: Repealing Outdated Labor Regulations: Food Stamp Placeholder Sections
description_of_action: Removes empty placeholder sections on food stamps.

action_name: Rescinding Pandemic-Era Mandates in OMH Facilities
description_of_action: Repeals COVID-19 vaccination requirements for staff in OMH facilities.

action_name: Expanding the Supply of Child Care Educators
agency: Office of Children and Family Services (OCFS)
description_of_action: Adds 18 eligible fields of study (e.g., Business Administration, Psychology, Nursing) that qualify educators for group teacher and director roles.

action_name: Reducing Delays Due to Duplicative Background Checks for Child Care Educators
agency: Office of Children and Family Services (OCFS)
description_of_action: Removes the repeat State Central Register check and medical statement when an approved educator joins a new program or site; 5-year renewal is retained.

action_name: Making It Easier to Operate Child Care in School Buildings
agency: Office of Children and Family Services (OCFS); State Education Department (SED)
description_of_action: OCFS will waive overlapping facility requirements for school-age child care in school buildings that comply with SED regulations.

action_name: Broadening Pathways for Child Care Educators to Grow Their Careers
agency: Office of Children and Family Services (OCFS)
description_of_action: Allows educators with a CDA and extensive qualifying experience to serve as directors without pursuing a bachelor's degree.

action_name: Providing Flexibility for Child Care Directors to Serve Multiple Sites
agency: Office of Children and Family Services (OCFS)
description_of_action: Extends the multi-site director arrangement from school-age programs to day care centers, allowing directors to cover two sites.

action_name: Faster Certification for Mental Health Services
description_of_action: Updates the Prior Approval Review process to allow reclassification of project review level based on community impact, complexity, and cost; ~1,700 programs affected.

action_name: Reducing Reporting Frequency for Nursing Homes
description_of_action: Reduces HERDS bed census reporting from weekly to monthly for 598 nursing homes.

action_name: Streamlining Home Care Agency Reporting
description_of_action: Folds a redundant LHCSA report into the annual registration process for ~1,200 home care providers.

action_name: Virtual Casework for Young Adults in Foster Care
agency: Office of Children and Family Services (OCFS)
description_of_action: Permits virtual caseworker visits, with informed consent, for youth 18+ in foster care and youth discharged but under district supervision.

action_name: Modernizing Community College Residency Rules
description_of_action: Replaces out-of-state tuition penalties for missing the 30-day residency filing deadline with a late fee; removes redundant residency certificates for dual-enrolled high school students.

action_name: Authorizing Tuition Liability Waivers for Student Hardship
description_of_action: Allows campuses to waive tuition liability for students facing emergencies in the second half of a term.

action_name: Safeguarding Affordable Housing in Rural Communities
description_of_action: First RRAP update in 15 years; authorizes direct state rent subsidies and oversight as federal loans mature and subsidies expire.

action_name: Modernizing the Department of Labor Payroll System
description_of_action: Payroll portal upgrades: saved employee profiles, pre-populated data, bulk upload, in-system guidance, and a submission window extended from 30 to 44 days; ~50,000 small businesses, 11,000+ hours saved annually.

action_name: Expanding Charitable Fundraising Through Beverage Labeling
description_of_action: Advisory interpretation allowing alcohol labels to feature charitable donation partnerships.

action_name: Updating Divisible Load Permit Eligibility for Freight Carriers
description_of_action: Repeals the rule limiting divisible load permits to NY-registered vehicles, conforming regulation to current practice.

action_name: Modernizing International Financial Filings
description_of_action: Updates supervisory policy to accept digital official certificates for legalization of foreign documents.

action_name: Streamlining Bank Subsidiary Investment Rules
description_of_action: Removes duplicative paperwork when banks and trust companies invest in operating subsidiaries and other businesses.

action_name: Modernizing Community Safety and Crime Prevention Rules
description_of_action: Repeals 1983 crime prevention regulations superseded by GIVE, SNUG, and RISE.

action_name: Rescinding Outdated Property Access Guidance
description_of_action: Rescinds two redundant memos on private property access language in mineral resource permits.

action_name: Correcting Permit Fee Refund Guidance
description_of_action: Rescinds outdated guidance on fees for withdrawn drilling permits to align with state law and practice.

action_name: Repealing Outdated Wildlife Management Area Regulations
description_of_action: Repeals property-specific WMA rules in favor of a single statewide public use framework.

action_name: Updating Environmental Protection Fund Regulations
agency: Office of Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation (OPRHP)
description_of_action: Technical corrections to the website URL, regional office addresses, and a section cross-reference.

action_name: Modernizing Labor Relations Claims and Dispute Procedures
description_of_action: Updates procedures under SERA and the Farm Laborers' Fair Labor Practices Act: e-signatures for showing of interest, filing time limits for improper practice charges, employer petitions on representation, and conduct rules.

action_name: Authorizing Electronic Filing and Eliminating Fax and Copy Requirements
description_of_action: Formally allows electronic filing of documents and pleadings, eliminates fax communications and unnecessary copy filing.

action_name: Eliminating Unnecessary Verification Requirements and Updating Affirmation Standards
description_of_action: Conforms affirmation forms to current CPLR standards.

action_name: Standardizing Motion Practice and Allowing Oral Summations
description_of_action: Standardizes motion practice and permits oral summations in place of written closing briefs.

action_name: Technical Corrections and Repealing Outdated Publication Rules
description_of_action: Repeals an obsolete rule governing award publications and makes technical corrections.

action_name: Eliminating Obsolete Certification Rule for Judges
description_of_action: Eliminates an unused rule allowing Workers' Compensation Law Judges to certify questions to the Board.

action_name: Rescinding Defunct Medical Appeals Unit Regulations (1 of 2)
description_of_action: Repeals a regulation governing the Medical Appeals Unit, inactive since at least 2020; functions now sit with the Medical Director's Office.

action_name: Rescinding Defunct Medical Appeals Unit Regulations (2 of 2)
description_of_action: Repeals a regulation governing the Medical Appeals Unit, inactive since at least 2020; functions now sit with the Medical Director's Office.

action_name: Repealing Practice Committee Regulations: Podiatry
description_of_action: Repeals the podiatry practice committee regulation; committee has not convened since at least 2020.

action_name: Repealing Practice Committee Regulations: Chiropractic
description_of_action: Repeals the chiropractic practice committee regulation; committee has not convened since at least 2020.

action_name: Repealing Practice Committee Regulations: Psychology
description_of_action: Repeals the psychology practice committee regulation; committee has not convened since at least 2020.

action_name: Repealing Disputed Medical Bill Regulations: Podiatry
description_of_action: Repeals the podiatry bill dispute process; now handled by the Medical Director's Office.

action_name: Repealing Disputed Medical Bill Regulations: Chiropractic
description_of_action: Repeals the chiropractic bill dispute process; now handled by the Medical Director's Office.

action_name: Repealing Disputed Medical Bill Regulations: Psychology
description_of_action: Repeals the psychology bill dispute process; now handled by the Medical Director's Office.

action_name: Repealing Disputed Medical Bill Regulations: Occupational/Physical Therapy
description_of_action: Repeals the OT/PT bill dispute process; now handled by the Medical Director's Office.

action_name: Removing Obsolete Third-Party Recovery Rules
description_of_action: Removes third-party recovery rules superseded by case law, including a legacy $200 funeral expense cap (now $12,500).

action_name: Repealing Obsolete Transitional Care Funding Rules
description_of_action: Repeals transitional care funding rules for youth aging out of foster care or residential schools; statutory authority expired in the 1990s.

action_name: Updating Public Inspection and Federal Citation Rules
description_of_action: Replaces 1980s federal citations and updates public inspection procedures for agency materials.

action_name: Eliminating Redundant Medicaid Self-Disclosure Filings
agency: Office of the Medicaid Inspector General (OMIG)
description_of_action: Eliminates self-disclosure statements for providers ineligible for the self-disclosure program.

action_name: Extending Provider Audit Response Deadlines
agency: Office of the Medicaid Inspector General (OMIG)
description_of_action: Extends Medicaid audit deadlines: draft report objections 30→45 days, draft-to-final 40→55 days, and pre-recoupment period 20→60 days.

action_name: Rescinding Obsolete Web Advertising Guidance
description_of_action: Rescinds an unused guideline on vendor advertising and sponsorships on agency websites.

action_name: Eliminating Redundant Social Security Number Guidance
description_of_action: Rescinds standalone SSN guidance duplicative of the Personal Privacy Protection Law, ahead of an overarching state privacy policy.

action_name: Removing Unnecessary ITS Technology Policies: Technology Purchasing
description_of_action: Rescinds a redundant internal technology purchasing policy, given ITS's existing statutory standard-setting authority.

action_name: Removing Unnecessary ITS Technology Policies: Standards-Setting
description_of_action: Rescinds a redundant internal standards-setting policy, given ITS's existing statutory standard-setting authority.

action_name: Removing Unnecessary ITS Technology Policies: Policy Exception Approvals
description_of_action: Rescinds a redundant internal policy exception approval policy, given ITS's existing statutory standard-setting authority.

action_name: Removing Outdated "Contact Us" Page Guidelines
description_of_action: Removes the standalone Contact Us page standard, now covered by the NYS Universal Web Navigation Standard.

action_name: Combining Digital Identity Credentialing Policy and Guidance
description_of_action: Merges the digital identity policy and standard into a single policy incorporating updated federal standards.

action_name: Consolidating Acceptable Use Guidance
description_of_action: Rescinds the standalone Bring Your Own Device policy and consolidates acceptable use guidance into one policy.
